title: Personal Kult C core, CPC and Sega tooling discovery pass
summary: Personally screen 77 search hits, review twelve roots, add nine projects including requested Kult C, defer two and exclude one starter.
notes: Root performed all discovery and publication personally, with no research worker, PR or new branch. Four fresh repository searches and the explicit user-supplied Kult C URL were screened against current main. Twelve relevant roots received primary-source review, with immutable blob-verified evidence. Earlier Kult C deferral remains historical; explicit user direction now promotes the core with architecture and non-playable limits intact. Do not conflate core, matching ASM and desktop backend. Standalone tools are distinguished from thin packaging, generic starter repositories and upstream dependencies. No upstream code, firmware, game or emulator was executed. Sparse README claims were checked against implementation; bundled binaries are not source/build verification.

sources.reason: Native CPC utility measures floppy rotation speed, searches sector IDs and assists head alignment. Source includes direct FDC routines, firmware numeric operations and a Z80 interrupt timer.

Python pixel-art/editor implementation with CPC firmware/hardware palette mappings and mode-dependent pixel packing for modes 0, 1 and 2. Reviewed image conversion code in addition to the short README.
Command-line batch tape conversion frontend supporting WAV, CDT DRB/CSW and CSW1.1/2.0 outputs, with directory filtering and optional recursion. Actual dispatch to CTape readers/writers inspected.
Windows WPF sprite manipulation tool with CPC mode0/1/2 palette handling and explicit firmware/hardware/RGB colour conversion. Actual palette class and UI project inspected.
Browser-based CPC snapshot-header inspection for Z80 registers, CRTC, gate array, bank mapping and palette, with companion ImHex structures for versions and extension chunks.
Linux workflows assemble DAAD adventure distributions for multiple retro systems and HTML. Inspected CPC script builds DDB/interpreter data, prepares images and inserts outputs into a disk image.
C++ Sega emulator implementation with Z80 and 68000 cores, machine memory maps, VDP/audio components and SDL2 event/render loop. Source selects SG-1000/SMS/GG and Genesis paths.

Python cartridge-image library separates copier-stub detection, Sega header anchors/region/size, checksum, file identity and manifest comparison. Inspected actual header/checksum and dump code, not only coverage statistics.

Excluded at inspected revision: generic React/Vite starter documentation and a single Star Draw heading, with no demonstrated retro-development function. A suggestive repository name is not an implementation.

Deferred as a thin historical integration bundle: Pasmo/iDSK sources and binaries plus a short Sublime build command and AppleScript launcher. Distinct substantive functionality beyond already tracked toolchains not established; no Mac compatibility claim from bundled old binaries.

Deferred pending a focused execution-architecture review of the separate desktop backend. README reports playable Windows/Linux and CMake replaces OS/hardware headers through a host HAL, but it also imports the reconstructed flat-memory core. Preserve its relationship and upstream claims without automatically asserting native-translation or baked-emulation classification from no-emulator wording.

source_updates.reason: Readable C reconstruction derived from the separately tracked matching Atari ST assembly. README describes 33 modules, 423 identified functions and differential checking against Musashi. Included at the user's explicit request; preserve core/reconstruction scope rather than call this repository a playable port.

relationships.narrative: Matching ASM lives in kult-atari-st-decomp; playable SDL3 backend is a separate kult-atari-st-pc-port repository. That port imports this core with local deltas. The previous dated deferral is superseded for inclusion by the user request, while architecture limits remain documented.
